mixed_income_rule: Keep a property when it has qualifying ARCH/MFTE/moderate-income units even if the same property also has lower-income units. Exclude only when the relevant inventory is exclusively within an excluded category.

verification_rule: A listing signal is not treated as proof of a qualifying vacancy. Program eligibility, bedroom, rent, income restriction, and current availability must be verified against the property/leasing source.
